about: Custom types P2: guards Phase 1's pregnancy conversion end to end. In fixture 'type_removed_b' (the wolf mod removed) the captive in cell B carries a goblin, the wolf's like, instead of a wolf. A captive of the same class with that pregnancy gives birth in a BIRTH 2 cell: the infant is a goblin and the goblins of monster class 0 grow (at least 1: the nest has a birth of its own in the window), the kept wolves (10) are untouched. The wolf mod stays out; harness_type_cell stays in, or cell B would be gone.
